question: In a certain code language, 'BLUES' is written as 'HVFOY'. How will 'FORCED' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d0505d307612d6cf1dce5e97401a8ced54be79a5519712f21135f64c8fc7df.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Letters of the word are coded according to the equivalent opposite letter of a particular letter of the word.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13a1bbe2afc437c5709de41c1dc6db997305877d1fa6813a49cbbc3309b665d2.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6b28748090ccb685411f31873a24d8a8da2676af68043131847937a0a2afd24.png] 

Hence, '**WVXILU**' is the correct answer.
